question: Does discovery-derived boundary adaptation engagement predict whether v/g + refractory/delay clearing suppresses stored-memory expression in a fresh outcome-blind cohort?

selection.event_selection: first natural reward at or after decision index 60

moderator.timing: after exact prefix lag -21 and before boundary intervention
moderator.intermediate_policy: record and skip from target strata

runtime.boundary: after source lag -21 and before source lag -20
runtime.terminal_sequence: exact source lags -20 through -1 followed by exact reward cue at lag 0

effect_label.suppression: clear_vg_delay is lower than intact on all three primary endpoints
effect_label.reversal: clear_vg_delay is higher than intact on all three primary endpoints

validation.primary_directional_target: engaged suppression count is greater than quiescent suppression count
validation.secondary_directional_target: engaged mean candidate-minus-intact delta is more negative than quiescent mean delta on all three primary endpoints
validation.prefix_crosscheck: report whether lag -21 changed-KC and changed-edge expression are jointly nonzero within each adaptation stratum
